title: Argentina at the World Cup
description: From Maradona to Messi — La Albiceleste's World Cup story.

questions.q: How many World Cups have Argentina won?
Who captained Argentina to the 1986 title?
questions.explain: Maradona led and inspired the 1986 winners in Mexico.

questions.q: Argentina won their first title in 1978 while doing what?
questions.explain: Argentina hosted and won the 1978 World Cup.

questions.q: In the 2022 final, Argentina beat France how?
questions.explain: A 3–3 thriller was settled 4–2 on penalties.

questions.q: Who won the Golden Ball as best player of the 2022 World Cup?
questions.explain: Messi won it as Argentina lifted the trophy.

questions.q: Argentina lost the 1990 final to which team?
questions.explain: West Germany won 1–0 in Rome, a rematch of 1986.

questions.q: Argentina also lost the 2014 final — to whom?
questions.explain: Germany won 1–0 after extra time in Brazil.

questions.q: Who is Argentina's all-time leading World Cup goalscorer?
questions.explain: Messi overtook Batistuta to become Argentina's top World Cup scorer.

questions.q: Emiliano Martínez won which award at the 2022 World Cup?
questions.explain: Martínez was outstanding throughout, saving crucial penalties and winning the Golden Glove for the tournament's best goalkeeper.

questions.q: In which year did Argentina make their World Cup debut?
questions.explain: Argentina played in the very first World Cup in 1930, reaching the final before losing 4–2 to hosts Uruguay.
